content: Case 2026/0412. Phone call 8 September 2026. Applicant confirmed employment at Example Logistics continues. Applicant said they had been unwell in August and missed two shifts. Advised that a decision would follow a review of the documents.

title: Prior correspondence, overpayment notification
content: Case 2026/0412. Letter advising the applicant of a possible overpayment for January to May 2026 and inviting a response within 14 days. No response received.

title: Hardship policy guide, version 3
content: Version 3. A delegate may waive a debt where recovery would cause severe financial hardship. The delegate considers income, essential outgoings and the circumstances of the debt. Decisions should be made within 28 days of a complete application.

title: Hardship policy guide, version 4
content: Version 4, effective 1 July 2026. A delegate may waive a debt, in whole or in part, where recovery would cause serious financial hardship and the debt did not arise from the applicant's knowingly false statement. The delegate considers income, essential outgoings, household composition and the circumstances of the debt. Decisions should be made within 21 days of a complete application.

title: Instrument of delegation, debt waiver decisions
content: Delegation of the power to waive debts on hardship grounds to officers at Team Leader level and above. Delegates must record the basis of each decision.

title: Hardship policy guide, version 5 (draft for consultation)
content: Draft version 5, for consultation, not approved. Applicants with a current medical certificate are treated as meeting the hardship test without a separate income assessment.

title: Copy of instrument of delegation (team shared drive)
content: Delegation of the power to waive debts on hardship grounds to officers at Team Leader level and above. Delegates must record the basis of each decision.

title: Community forum post about hardship waivers
content: Forum post: In my experience most hardship waivers are decided within 28 days and you almost always get it if you have payslips.
